scripts.resume:pdf: npm run -s resume:image && docker run --rm -u $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/work resume-tex latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -outdir=public -auxdir=.latex-build resume/resume.tex
scripts.resume:watch: npm run -s resume:image && docker run --rm -it -u $(id -u):$(id -g) -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/work resume-tex latexmk -pdf -pvc -view=none -interaction=nonstopmode -outdir=public -auxdir=.latex-build resume/resume.tex
